adj/7p-hex-ip.notes: Seven circular optics, cooling fins and double floor yoke.

adj/jolt-bar-fx2.body_style: linear rectangular bar with central white LED strip, RGB LED fields, and end brackets
adj/jolt-bar-fx2.notes: LED quantity sourced as 448 RGB plus 112 cool-white emitters; bracket/body detail should follow official product imagery and CAD.

adj/encore-lp12z-ip.body_style: compact circular-front LED PAR with projecting lens, finned housing, and double-arm scissor yoke
adj/encore-lp12z-ip.notes: Twelve RGBL LED modules documented. No inferred individual lens counts beyond those modules.

adj/jolt-300.body_style: short rectangular strobe panel with central white LED row, flanking RGB LED rows, and single yoke
adj/jolt-300.notes: Official page gives 144 white and 144 RGB SMD LEDs; emitter group count does not define lens geometry.

etc/desire-fresnel-7.notes: DFL7 is a fixed 7-inch aperture variant; allow lens travel in depth.

etc/colorsource-par.body_style: compact round LED PAR with yoke
etc/colorsource-par.notes: Original ColorSource PAR RGB-L array, black housing; not Deep Blue or Pearl color-array options.

high-end-systems/solaframe-1000.notes: Fixture variant available with different LED engine options; not a geometry variant.

high-end-systems/solaframe-2000.body_style: large LED framing head with yoke and circular lens
high-end-systems/solaframe-2000.notes: 600 W light engine; overall input draw varies by line voltage. Multiple engine variants.

robe-lighting/iforte.body_style: large sealed moving profile with yoke
robe-lighting/iforte.notes: iFORTE standard IP65 body; not FS, Fresnel, or LTX variant.

robe-lighting/tarrantula.body_style: multi-source rounded head with RGBA pixel array
robe-lighting/tarrantula.notes: 37 RGBA LED multichips; beam shaper is removable, but the shown standard assembly includes it.

claypaky/sinfonya-profile-600.body_style: theatre moving profile with yoke and large circular lens
claypaky/sinfonya-profile-600.notes: Sinfonya Profile 600 standard model; RGBAL source. Manufacturer lists 14 optical lenses and 165 mm front lens.

claypaky/volero-wave.body_style: linear chassis with eight individually tilting optical heads
claypaky/volero-wave.notes: Independent modules tilt 220 degrees; product on demand. Render as a fixed bar with separate head pivots.

chauvet-professional/colordash-par-h7x.body_style: round-front compact PAR can with 7-cell hex-color engine and double yoke

chauvet-professional/colordash-par-h12x-.body_style: round-front sealed die-cast PAR housing with double-bracket yoke
chauvet-professional/colordash-par-h12x-.notes: Twelve hex-color modules documented; body orientation should be checked against official CAD.

chauvet-professional/colordash-par-quad-.body_style: round metal PAR with 18-cell front array and split yoke
chauvet-professional/colordash-par-quad-.notes: Legacy product, marked as such on manufacturer page. Product manual Rev. 6 diagrams show front, side, and rear views.

elation-professional/sixbar-500.body_style: compact linear die-cast bar with six independent LED cells, dual integrated rigging brackets and glare shield
elation-professional/sixbar-500.notes: Legacy product; stated overall width includes the supplied glare shield.

elation-professional/vbar-270.body_style: legacy short linear RGB bar with dense 5 mm LED array and mounting bracket
elation-professional/vbar-270.notes: 270 LEDs (90 each red, green, blue) documented. Manufacturer calls product discontinued.

martin-professional-harman/mac-viper-per.body_style: discharge moving head with framing module, yoke
martin-professional-harman/mac-viper-per.notes: Estimate uses documented head-straight-up height, maximum width, and head length. Do not read as the bounding box from one manufacturer-dimensioned pose.

martin-professional-harman/mac-aura.body_style: 19-lens RGBW moving wash with secondary Aura backlight
martin-professional-harman/mac-aura.notes: Official Martin optics table specifies 19 x 10 W RGBW; secondary Aura illumination is not counted as lenses.

vari-lite/vl800-eventprofile.notes: Black and white body variants; housing shape otherwise same.

vari-lite/vl2600-se-wash.body_style: mid-size wash head with yoke and automated barn doors
vari-lite/vl2600-se-wash.notes: Do not substitute dimensions of legacy VL2600 Wash for the SE version.

claypaky/mini-b.body_style: compact yoke head with central LED and six outer lenses
claypaky/mini-b.notes: Seven RGBW LEDs; keep central LED optically distinct from outer ring.

claypaky/tambora-flash.body_style: IP66 rectangular modular fixture with four central reflector cells and two strobe strips
claypaky/tambora-flash.notes: Four RGBWW reflector optics plus two lines of segmented white strobe LEDs; handles excluded from dimensions.

glp/impression-x5-ip-maxx.body_style: large IP65 moving wash head with 37 circular RGBL lenses
glp/impression-x5-ip-maxx.notes: 37 x 40 W RGBL pixel array; avoid using the similar non-IP impression X5 body.

glp/jdc-line-1000.body_style: linear hybrid strobe and RGB pixel mapping fixture
glp/jdc-line-1000.notes: The 1000 mm lens tube shares RGB pixel and white strobe emission; a single continuous tube is a better shape representation than separate visible LEDs.
